approved.title: Lemmer named John O. Hallquist Endowed Professor in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
approved.summary: KALAMAZOO, Mich.— Dr. Kristina M. Lemmer, a leading researcher in plasma and electric propulsion for spacecraft, has been named a John O. Hallquist Endowed Professor in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at Western Michigan University.
approved.source: WMU College of Engineering and Applied Sciences
